page_1.title: Purpose and assignment
page_1.raw_text:
Purpose and assignment

SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.

The assigned CHW records a synthetic referral need for the current patient.

The CHW assignment and facility selection must come from an approved deployment topology, not from a manual, patient note, or array order.

page_2.title: Capability selection
page_2.raw_text:
Capability selection

For a SYNTHETIC_EMERGENCY need, select facilities with the emergency-care capability.

For a SYNTHETIC_NUTRITION need, select facilities with the nutrition-support capability.

If no eligible facility is returned, record unassigned and request operational review.

page_3.title: No guessing
page_3.raw_text:
No guessing

Do not name a facility identifier in the clinical artifact.

Do not use an inactive CHW or a facility without the required capability.

Record the topology snapshot, relation, and capability code with the referral plan.
